explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and at every GO where the agent chooses a1 or the previous trial was rewarded. It turns on only at GO when the agent chooses a2 right after an unrewarded trial: about 4-6 after a single loss, 8-10 after two or more losses in a row, and only about 1-4 before trial 60 in the episode.
